payload.question: Your work email appeared in the RockYou2024 compilation (10B passwords). This was a compilation of many previous breaches. Your IT team has forced a password reset. What additional steps should YOU take?
options: Enable MFA on all accounts linked to that email, check for active sessions, and review account recovery options
The IT-forced reset is sufficient — password rotation covers all risk
Create a new personal email address and migrate all accounts to it
Run antivirus software to check if your device was compromised

explanation: A password reset addresses credential theft but not account takeover that may have already occurred. Check for: (1) active sessions you don't recognize and revoke them, (2) recovery email/phone tampering — attackers often change these to maintain access after a password reset, (3) enable MFA so a stolen password alone isn't enough. Antivirus addresses a different threat vector (malware).
